summary.text: Aarón Ortíz is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 1st District, serving since January 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography describes a former educator and college counselor with Chicago Public Schools who holds a B.S. in urban planning from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
It says Ortíz is a lifelong resident of Chicago's Gage Park neighborhood and a member of the Chicago Teachers Union and of the Local School Council for Back of the Yards High School.
